title: Castlevania: Dracula X - Death of Richter
description:
The death jingle from Castlevania: Dracula X that plays when Richter Belmont... turns into stone in midair after taking too much damage? (I think that's what happens to him).

Use it for death jingles or game overs.

Made this port a long time ago with Vitor's SPC2MML tool. Surprised this one jingle came out just right when ripping the SPC.
